recommendation: Keep the commit. The authoritative resource definition and generated compartment spreadsheet already reflect the Jira decision; this follow-up keeps the active example valid against the current definition.
issue_request: FHIR-51729 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested removing unused CompartmentDefinition elements because only HL7 can define core CompartmentDefinition instances; the final resolution removed CompartmentDefinition.resource.documentation and populated start/end parameter mappings instead of removing startParam/endParam.
initial_application: The upstream FHIR commit d116faa04d484120c90b33bc0d06cfe038915d42 removed CompartmentDefinition.resource.documentation from source/compartmentdefinition/structuredefinition-CompartmentDefinition.xml and added date/startdate/enddate columns to source/compartments.xml. That left source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-example.xml with two stale documentation children even though the example is listed as an active CompartmentDefinition example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists compartmentdefinition as an active resource, and list-CompartmentDefinition-examples.xml lists CompartmentDefinition/example. FHIR-I minutes for 2025-11-03 confirm the 14-0-0 motion to remove .documentation and populate start/end params. FHIR-51725 is adjacent context for removing reliance on documentation prose, and FHIR-51607 concerns a separate extension path for post-R6 additional resources.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty source fix on the combined branch that removes the two stale <documentation> elements from source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-example.xml.
source_changes: source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-example.xml: removed the two resource.documentation elements from Communication and CommunicationRequest entries.

related_jiras.note: Same 2025-11-03 CompartmentDefinition discussion clarified that resources without .param are outside a compartment and removed reliance on resource.documentation prose.
Records a separate tooling-extension path for post-R6 additional-resource compartment declarations, including documentation there rather than in core CompartmentDefinition.
Earlier no-change discussion about making CompartmentDefinition.resource.documentation markdown is superseded for core by FHIR-51729's removal.
